sections.title: Income tax: individual scale

source.title: Income tax return for employees and wage earners (form A4), with its instructions

sections.basis: annual taxable income of individuals (after exemptions and accepted donations), in new Israeli shekels; the form does not give the date of the amending law, so the fact is dated from the start of the tax year

rows.label: Personal exemption (resident individuals)
rows.note: personal exemption of a resident natural person (ILS 30,000 for 2014 and earlier years).

source.title: Income tax return for individuals (form A1)

rows.label: Transport exemption (10% of annual salary or actual costs)
rows.note: transport allowance: actual transport costs or 10% of the annual salary, whichever is lower.

source.title: Income tax return for individuals (form A1)

rows.label: Home purchase or construction exemption (once)
rows.note: once-only exemption for buying or building a home (alternatively the housing-loan interest exemption).

source.title: Income tax return for individuals (form A1)

rows.label: Housing loan interest exemption (yearly maximum, up to 10 years)
rows.note: housing-loan interest exemption, up to ILS 4,000 a year for at most 10 years (instead of the once-only home exemption).

source.title: Income tax return for individuals (form A1)

rows.label: University study exemption (per student, at most two)
rows.note: per university student (the taxpayer, the spouse or a child), at most two students a year, except students holding a grant or scholarship.

source.title: Income tax return for individuals (form A1)

rows.label: Donations: deductible up to 20% of taxable income
rows.note: accepted donations, deductible up to 20% of taxable income. Unit: share of taxable income.

source.title: Income tax return for employees and wage earners (form A4), with its instructions

rows.label: Pension, savings and health insurance contributions exempt
rows.value: Contributions to pension, savings and health insurance funds, or any other fund approved by the Minister of Finance, are exempt.

source.title: Income tax return for individuals (form A1)

rows.label: Tax residence: 120 days (Palestinians) or 183 days (others)
rows.value: A Palestinian is resident after at least 120 days in Palestine in the year (or when employed by the State of Palestine or a local authority); a non-Palestinian individual after at least 183 days.

source.title: Income tax return for employees and wage earners (form A4), with its instructions

rows.label: Discount for early filing of the annual return (4% or 2%)
rows.value: A return filed in January of the following year earns a discount of 4% of the tax balance due after advance payments; 2% when filed in February or March.

source.title: Income tax services guide (دليل الخدمات)
Income tax return for individuals (form A1)

rows.label: Rental income: 40% of the property tax paid is deductible
rows.value: Rental income is taxed with other income; 40% of the urban property tax (musaqqafat) paid is deducted as a direct expense of the let property.

source.title: Income tax return for individuals (form A1)
Income tax return for individuals (form A1)

rows.label: VAT exempt-dealer turnover limit (liberal professions excluded)
rows.note: annual business turnover up to which a person (other than members of the liberal professions) is registered as an exempt dealer outside VAT; the law states the amount in Jordanian dinars or its equivalent in legal tender. Decree-Law No. 26 of 2024, published in the Official Gazette on 31 December 2024, applies six months after publication (Article 124).

source.title: Decree-Law No. 26 of 2024 on Value Added Tax (Official Gazette, special issue 30, 31 December 2024)

rows.label: VAT standard rate
rows.note: VAT on all transactions in the State and on imports of goods; the Council of Ministers may lower the rate or set different rates up to 16%. Decree-Law No. 26 of 2024, published in the Official Gazette on 31 December 2024, applies six months after publication (Article 124).

source.title: Decree-Law No. 26 of 2024 on Value Added Tax (Official Gazette, special issue 30, 31 December 2024)

rows.label: VAT on financial institutions (profits and wages)
rows.note: financial institutions pay VAT at the Article 2 rate on their profits and wages; a year's loss offsets that year's wages, without carry-forward. Decree-Law No. 26 of 2024, published in the Official Gazette on 31 December 2024, applies six months after publication (Article 124).

source.title: Decree-Law No. 26 of 2024 on Value Added Tax (Official Gazette, special issue 30, 31 December 2024)

rows.label: VAT zero rate: exports and services to non-residents
rows.value: Exports of goods and intangible property, services to non-residents and services supplied abroad by a business based in Palestine are zero-rated (Article 32, with further zero-rated cases).

source.title: Decree-Law No. 26 of 2024 on Value Added Tax (Official Gazette, special issue 30, 31 December 2024)

rows.label: VAT exempt transactions
rows.value: Exempt: residential and commercial letting (not hotels or leisure), sales by exempt dealers, deposits with financial institutions, raw stone, diamonds and precious stones, school and university fees, doctors' consultations at the official tariff, and sales of flats and shops (Article 33).

source.title: Decree-Law No. 26 of 2024 on Value Added Tax (Official Gazette, special issue 30, 31 December 2024)

rows.label: VAT on e-commerce purchases from abroad
rows.value: Goods bought from abroad through e-commerce are subject to VAT at the standard rate and handled under the customs law; anyone trading electronically on a commercial basis must register (Article 22).

source.title: Decree-Law No. 26 of 2024 on Value Added Tax (Official Gazette, special issue 30, 31 December 2024)

rows.label: VAT and non-profit institutions
rows.value: Non-profit institutions are exempt if they distribute no profits to members; they pay VAT on activities that compete with the private sector outside their main charitable purpose (Article 4).

source.title: Decree-Law No. 26 of 2024 on Value Added Tax (Official Gazette, special issue 30, 31 December 2024)
Decree-Law No. 26 of 2024 on Value Added Tax (Official Gazette, special issue 30, 31 December 2024)

sections.title: Freelancers, contractors and the self-employed

rows.label: VAT as a fixed amount for small liberal professions (by Council of Ministers decision)
rows.value: The Council of Ministers may, on the Minister's proposal, levy VAT as a fixed amount on small liberal professions and services whose owners cannot keep books of account (Article 2(3)).

source.title: Decree-Law No. 26 of 2024 on Value Added Tax (Official Gazette, special issue 30, 31 December 2024)
Decree-Law No. 26 of 2024 on Value Added Tax (Official Gazette, special issue 30, 31 December 2024)

sections.note: Self-employed contributions, withholding on payments to freelancers and contractors, simplified regimes for small businesses, and expat and digital-nomad rules.
